status: Native DICOM RLE subset implemented and verified; full DICOM and 100-format qualification remain incomplete

implementation.codec: Owned Rust PackBits, row boundaries, 8/16-bit scalar and RGB byte planes, MSB-first reconstruction into LE output; no production pydicom or LibRaw
implementation.container: Transfer syntax 1.2.840.10008.1.2.5; one fragment per frame; bounded exact BOT/fragment/delimiter parsing; selected-frame allocation only
implementation.compatibility: Standard requires encapsulated OB; accepts legacy OW seen in packaged 16-bit sources as opaque bytes without swapping
implementation.memory: Managed source, selected raw scratch, palette scratch/profile and output; exact peak and short-budget tests, cancellation and malformed-input checks

pipeline.prefetch: Decoder blocked; reverse requests restore swap, stale generation refused; per-call watchdog excludes GPU readback time
pipeline.ttl: 50ms insertion TTL, pinned expired visible frame preserved; oversized pinned frame rejects smaller byte policy; future insertion TTL switched to60s before prefetch phase

initial_failures.legacy_OW: Initial decoder rejected packaged 16-bit OW; fixed and external comparison passes
initial_failures.ram_hit: Waiting for disk before warm hit could consume50ms TTL; warm-hit assertion now precedes unrelated disk wait
initial_failures.policy: Full1MiB pinned frame cannot accept4KiB policy; regression now asserts refusal before foreground transition
initial_failures.external_setup: Initial broad ignored filter lacked unrelated oracle environment variables; rerun with all required variables passed7

limits: Other compressed transfer syntaxes remain unsupported
No clinical presentation or full DICOM qualification claimed
NVIDIA/CUDA deferred per user; this run verifies Metal only
RAM admission accounting is not process RSS; this is not physical slow-disk benchmarking

checks.scope: No claim of full workspace lint/build/test after these changes

corruption_regression.scope: Full public DICOM decoder, both selected frames, borrowed source and zero managed output budget
corruption_regression.valid_control: Unmodified input reaches typed Memory error with zero budget
corruption_regression.damaged_control: Every truncated or mutated input returns InvalidDicom rather than retryable Memory
corruption_regression.limit: Checks selected-frame codec data and all container headers; does not validate compressed packet contents of unselected frames or claim zero process heap allocation
